page.layout: One page of text, single column; heading block at top; large woodcut initial at start of first paragraph; signature mark "ij" with reference marks at bottom of text block; ink stamp at upper right (not transcribed).

main_text.l: ILLVSTRISSIMO
PRINCIPI, ET DOMINO,
D. FRIDERICHO, Palatino comiti
ad Rhenum, Electoralis Palatinatus haeredi, Bavariae
Duci, Rectori magnifico Heidelbergensis Acade-
miae, Domino clementissimo, Gratiam, pacem,
salutem a Deo Patre & Domino Iesu Christo.
VAE fuerunt causae, Illustrissime Princeps,
Rector magnifice, eaeque pergraves (nisi me ani-
mus fallit) quae me ad exarandum hoc breve
σύνταγμα his paucis diebus adduxerunt: ju-
ventutis studiosae commodum, & hujus Aca-
demiae. Etenim quae res juventuti in studio-
rum suorum ratione sint commoda, utilia, atque salutaria, majores
nostri providerunt sapientissime, legibusque optimis procurave-
runt: quid Academiae huic nostrae sit necessarium, nos omnes do-
cuit proximi superioris anni calamitas. Ac commune quidem
bonum hujus Academiae nostrae existimationemque in eo maxime
versari constat, ut doctissimus vir omnique doctrinarum genere
instructa, sanctis legibus circummunita, potentissimorum Princi-
pum & patronorum (quorum in numero est C. T.) praesidio fir-
mata perfler, omnique instrumento suo apte occupato & collocato
sancte legitimeque gubernetur: hoc vidit antiquitas, hoc nostra tem-
pora experta sunt, & boni sentiunt. Quae omnia si per Illustris-
simum Principem, heroemque fortissimum, D. IOANNEM CAS-
IMIRUM, patruum ac tutorem tuum, Dominum nostrum
clementissimum, & per T. C. assequimur (assequimur autem, &
in dies magis ac magis assequemur) optime cum hac celebri Aca-
demia actum iri per Dei gratiam & benedictionem confidimus.
Studiosae vero juventutis commoda, quum certa via & ratio in-
ij

page.notes: Woodcut initial "D" at start of the first paragraph. Ink stamp at upper right is not transcribed. Reference marks "*" and "‿" appear in the text near the bottom of the page; the final word "in" is partly cut off at the edge, and the signature "ij" is set below the text block. Some letters in the lower lines are uncertain due to the print, notably "Principem" and "Concordia"-like words near "Ioannem", which are transcribed as printed.
